item.title: Somewhere Quiet and Hopeful

turns.text: Make me an illustration that feels quiet and a little hopeful. You pick the scene and style. No words.

item.tests: Whether the agent turns a vague mood into a coherent illustration without demanding unnecessary creative decisions from the user.
must_haves: The deliverable is an illustration rather than a photograph.
The composition conveys quiet through visual restraint, stillness, or spaciousness rather than busy action.
A visible cue such as gentle light, growth, or an opening conveys some hope rather than unrelieved gloom.
The scene and palette form a coherent mood rather than a collection of unrelated elements.

approvals.name: generate_image

style.prompt: A quiet, gently hopeful illustration: a small warmly lit cottage window at the edge of a rain-washed garden just before sunrise. In the foreground, one tiny yellow crocus emerges between dark wet stone steps; beyond it, soft sage grasses and a still pale-blue sky slowly warming to apricot near the horizon. Intimate human-scale composition, ample breathing room, subtle paper grain, matte gouache and colored-pencil textures, restrained muted blue-gray and sage palette with very small warm golden accents. Delicate imperfect hand-painted shapes, tender observational detail, soft diffuse light, peaceful rather than melancholy, understated hope rather than overt sentimentality. Beautiful editorial picture-book illustration. No people, no lettering, no text, no words, no typography, no signature, no watermark.
